import sys
import heapq

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1 + n]))
    k = n // 2
    median = heapq.nsmallest(k + 1, a)[-1]
    print(median)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
